overview: A profile of the personal and professional lives of world-class Paralympic athletes, highlighting the power of sport through community and advocacy.
title: Adaptive: Paris

overview: Alas Smith and Jones is a British comedy sketch television series starring comedy duo and namesake Mel Smith and Griff Rhys Jones.
title: Alas Smith and Jones
Wo Cai Mei You Bang Jia Nv Ming Xing

overview: 13 Hours to Survive is an up-close look at the epic drama that occurs with the coming of each low tide. As the ocean recedes, sea animals become trapped in tide pools. In these miniature oceans the natural order is overturned and a struggle to survive is unleashed. The creatures have thirteen hours to survive, the time it takes for the tide to return. This underwater arena could be anywhere in the world, but this stunning series takes place near Roscoff in Brittany, France, with breathtaking windswept coasts that experience a daily tidal shift of 10 meters or more.
title: 13 Hours to Survive

overview: Julia Zemiro will host Crime Night! a comedy true-crime panel show where real-life cases are examined through the lens of criminology and comedy. Produced by Dreamchaser and Maverick Entertainment, the six-part series will see Julia, alongside a panel of criminologists and comedians dissect famous cases. They will discover the science behind the crimes and use that same science to examine our own lives with hilarious consequences.
title: Crime Night!

overview: Sport vs Money tells the inside story of the collision between football and business. Across four episodes, Jordan - the Premier League's youngest-ever owner - travels the globe to explore how decisions made by football's top executives in the early 1990s set in motion a transformation that has turned the world's most beloved sport into a vast entertainment industry.
title: Sport vs Money with Simon Jordan

overview: The show follows collectors as they discover the true monetary value of their massive and unusual collections. From an overwhelming stash of superhero figurines to cramped spaces stuffed with rare puppets and dolls and miniature sets that leave no room for actual, life-size furniture – these homes are begging for professional help, and the collectors must decide whether they are willing to sell some of their items to pay for the much-needed renovation. With a combination of humor, compassion and a celebration of the passionate collector in all of us, Bobby will support the homeowners through the process of sorting through, appraising and letting go of their stockpile, discovering the ‘found money' along the way to achieving their dream makeover.
title: Junk or Jackpot?

overview: Song Weiwei, the daughter of the first general of the Chen Kingdom, is determined to avenge the death of her father and the destruction of her kingdom. She replaces Wen Wenrou, the sister of Wen Zhiyuan, the most favored prince of the Liang Kingdom. She gradually gains Zhiyuan's trust, and even makes him fall in love with her. With the help of Wen Zhibai, who is fighting for the throne against Zhiyuan, she gradually dismantles Zhiyuan's plan of ascending the throne, succeeding in her revenge. However, she realizes that Zhiyuan has really fallen in love with her, and her crush has also been silently guarding her...
title: The Blade of Romance

overview: Not the Nine O'Clock News is a television comedy sketch show which was broadcast on BBC2 from 1979 to 1982. Originally shown as a comedy alternative to the Nine O'Clock News on BBC1. It featured satirical sketches on current news stories and popular culture, as well as parody songs, comedy sketches, re-edited videos, and spoof television formats. The show featured Rowan Atkinson, Pamela Stephenson, Mel Smith, and Griff Rhys Jones, as well as Chris Langham in the first series.
title: Not the Nine O'Clock News

overview: A young pregnant woman accepts help from a high-profile organization offering support — and becomes a prisoner in their sinister plot.
title: Baby Farm

overview: The story of the series begins late in the evening, in July 1993, at the moment when two brothers, Ivan and Stojan, arrive at their uncle's apartment, not far from the place where a conflict with tragic consequences just happened in Podgorica. The story continues in SPUŽ pre-trial prison. In parallel, we get to know the relationship between Ivan and his father Nikola, a serious and rational man, with whom Ivan has had a complicated relationship since childhood. These two stories are complicated and expanded, illuminating on the one hand the seductive life of one of Yugoslavia's biggest acting stars, but also the dark side of the nineties, the corrupt judiciary, the prison half-world. A gallery of colorful characters that our hero meets in prison, thieves, criminals, murderers, political prisoners, the atmosphere of the nineties in which all social and moral values were questioned, the key breaks in his intimate life, his relationship with his closest relatives, family, friends, courtroom scenes, his relationship to fame and popularity.
title: Pad
Zhong Zhi Ren Sheng De Shi Kong You Xiang
A Gentleman is Like a Mu

overview: Hardcore Pawn takes viewers behind the scenes of the immense American Jewelry & Loan, a family business owned by third-generation pawnbroker Les Gold. Working with Les are his son, Seth, who is being groomed to eventually take over the store, and daughter, Ashley, who thinks Seth isn't ready for the top job.
title: Hardcore Pawn

overview: The Housing Enforcers is a BBC One day-time television series that first aired on 1 September 2014. The series is hosted by presenter Matt Allwright and looks at the work of Local Authority Housing Officers who deal with disrepair and other Environmental Health related matters in the private rented housing sector in the UK.
title: The Housing Enforcers

overview: Jian Xiangxiang, a traditional incense maker, is devastated by a double betrayal—her boyfriend, Gu Jiacheng, betrays her in both love and career. Just when she's at her lowest, a barrage of mysterious on-screen comments (danmu) suddenly appears out of thin air, mocking her relentlessly. At first, Jian thinks she's hallucinating. But after several events unfold exactly as predicted, she realizes the comments have the power to foretell the future. They clearly warn her: in three months, Gu Jiacheng will have her committed to a psychiatric hospital. Determined to defy fate and take revenge, Jian sets her sights on Gu Jiacheng's third uncle—Gu Jingshi. Though Gu Jingshi is in a wheelchair, he exudes the cold, commanding aura of a true power player and is, in fact, the real head of the Gu family. Jian knows that tears and tantrums are for losers. If she wants Gu Jiacheng to fall to his knees and beg for forgiveness, she must become his aunt—Gu Jingshi's woman. Thus begins a calculated game of seduction that starts with strategy… and ends in irresistible obsession.
title: Blend Feelings

overview: In a chaotic era, a rich scion finds himself in love with a humble actress. Bound by social hierarchy, haunted by public rumors, and betrayed by their kin, their scarred hearts still inch closer with great care. The vibrant city hides undercurrents of conflict. Even a small stage reflects the turbulent times. No matter the difficulties, they vow to love fiercely amidst the turmoil.
title: Wild Fire

overview: In the spring of 2025, a shocking incident occurs where a popular actor stabbed his female manager with a knife and the news shocks the whole of Japan. Yoshikawa Keiko is a veteran manager at the bottom of despair when she happens to pass Moriyama Takuto on the street. Feeling a connection with him, Keiko invites him in the world of entertainment and does everything to make him debut as an actor. Slowly, Keiko invades Takuto's friendship and private life, and her love for him gradually escalates way beyond the role of a manager.
title: Dear My Baby: Watashi ga Anata wo Shihai suru made

overview: A recently widowed workaholic clumsily navigates life with his kids, guided by his late wife's online tips. Can he ace this crash course in parenthood?
title: Catalog

overview: Moments before her death, Fang Siyu learns the brutal truth, her husband Zhou Kai and best friend Jiang Yiyi swapped her newborn, murdered Jiang's husband Song Cheng, and plotted to silence her forever. Given a second chance, Fang joins forces with the resurrected Song Cheng to expose the conspiracy and cheat fate. As vengeance binds them, love blooms; together they unravel the villains' scheme, rewrite destiny, and step into a future forged by their own hands.
title: The Switch

overview: It's been said that history is written by those in power. But what about the outlaws, outcasts and rogues? What if they had their say? Rogue History shakes the dust off the history books to unravel myths, unearth narratives, and discover fresh perspectives.
title: Rogue History

overview: 31-year-old Hara Heisuke is a teacher at a high school in Shizuoka. He is like most people rather than an exceptional person. But an unfortunate accident which occurred 14 years ago ended up messing up his life. Feeling responsible, he stuck to his hometown and alma mater from then on. Meanwhile, it is decided that the boys school where he works will be merged with a girls school in the same area because of a decline in student numbers next year.
title: Gomen ne Seishun!

overview: A spin-off on #Remolove: Futsuu no Koi wa Jado drama.
title: Ren'ai Shinkaron

overview: Mr and Mrs was a UK television game show that aired on the ITV network from 1972. The format of the show was couples answering 3 questions about each other while the other half of each couple were kept in a sound-proof booth.
title: Mr & Mrs

overview: Michael Savage delivers his insights on politics, culture, faith and more as he seeks to save Western Civilization!
title: Michael Savage: Savage Nation

overview: Follow the lives of circus artists as they go about their daily routines surviving the twists and turns life throws at them.
title: Circus

overview: Phir Bhi Dil Hai Hindustani chronicles the family of Bharat Bhushan, a perfect patriot. Bharat's (Translation: India's) family includes his three sons – Om, Jai, and Jagdish, his three daughters-in-law – Ganga, Jamuna, Saraswati and his four grandchildren – Ram, Shyam, Munna and Munni, all of whom live in a house named Bharat Niwas (Translation: India House) and personify the multi – cultural diversity of India.
title: Phir Bhi Dil Hai Hindustani

overview: All Star Mr & Mrs is a British television show which first began airing on 12 April 2008 on ITV. It is a celebrity revival of the original Mr & Mrs that aired on ITV from 1968 to 1988 with two separate revivals in 1995–1996 and 1999 and was also based on the Canadian game show of the same name. The programme is hosted by Phillip Schofield, although Fern Britton co-hosted the show with Schofield between 2008 and 2010. The show features celebrities and their real-life partners playing to win up to £30,000 for their chosen charity.
title: All Star Mr & Mrs
Tonight, On the First Basement Floor of Babel
Shan Hun Hou Lu Zong You Zheng You Qiang

overview: Serial play by Daniel Owen.
title: Enoc Huws

overview: The period drama, Treflan, is based on three books by Daniel Owen, the novelist and tailor from Yr Wyddgrug, namely Y Treflan, Rhys Lewis and Enoc Huws. Set in the Victorian era the series follows the story of popular characters from the novels who live in a small town typical of Daniel Owen's hometown in Yr Wydgrug in the 19th century. During this period religion, the industrial revolution and the agricultural industry played a prominent role in people's lives.
title: Treflan

overview: With exclusive access to astonishing new research, historian Bettany Hughes unravels the enigma of the Nabataeans: the influential ancient people who history forgot.
title: Bettany Hughes' Lost Worlds: The Nabataeans

overview: Thomas Rouclair and Éli Mandokan are at the helm of this social experiment in which ten visitors, each with a secret, are brought together in an isolated chalet. Every day, one murderer, one victim. They will have to lie, investigate and murder. And only one will walk away a winner with up to $50,000.
title: Aller simple : la téléréalité

overview: Without them, the natural balance would be thrown out of balance: Ants and beetles maintain their environment through composting and pollination. They also fascinate with their survival strategies – from the leaf-cutter ant, which cultivates mushrooms, to the oil beetle, which sneaks into beehives. A journey to these colorful and bizarre six-legged creatures, both in the South American rainforest and here in Europe.
title: Fabelhafte Insekten

overview: When the owner of Oscar's Hotel leaves on important business, he entrusts the establishment and its gallery of monstrous residents to his nephew Oliver - resulting in more than a little bit of chaos.
title: Oscar's Hotel for Fantastical Creatures

overview: Looks at seven Australian photographers, each with an impressive body of work and unique photographic style
title: Language Of Light

overview: In the small town of Ringaryd in Småland, three young people find a chest with hidden letters. The letters tell of a 3,000-year-old statue that has disappeared under mysterious circumstances. It turns out that a curse rests on the statue and strange things start to happen when the past catches up with them. The series is based on the beloved classic by Maria Gripe and Kay Pollak.
title: Tordyveln flyger i skymningen

overview: Sergei Yesaulov's life can be called ideal — he has a job he loves, a wife and a beautiful daughter. Everything changes when a banal family quarrel leads to irreversible consequences: the daughter gets into an accident, and Yesaulov finds his wife strangled in bed. From that moment on, the man becomes the main suspect in the murder. Sergei begins his own investigation to figure out and punish the killer. And in order not to stay on the street, he gets a job at taxi company No. 13.
title: Таксопарк № 13

overview: Haruka is a "plain jane" who left the countryside to start her college life at Tokyo. She's secretly in love with Kurotaki, a coworker at her part-time job, but she lacks the self-confidence to confess her feelings to him. Then she meets Hikaru, a glamorous but sharp-tongued fashionista who begrudingly agrees to play "fairy godmother" for Haruka. However, there's more to Hikaru than meets the eye!
title: Cinderella Closet

overview: When his wife Agustina falls into delirium, a professor delves into her dark past to piece together her story and uncover the cause of her madness.
title: Delirio

overview: Everything you need to know as markets open across Europe. With analysis you won't find anywhere else, we break down the biggest stories of the day and speak to top guests who have skin in the game. Hosted by Anna Edwards, Guy Johnson and Kriti Gupta.
title: Bloomberg The Opening Trade

overview: Meen, a fifth-year medical student, cherishes a studious life filled with the joyful company of friends like Bon, Flint, Kim, Baikhao, and Pokpong. One day, Meen's mother sends Tul, the son of her close friend, who has recently passed the entrance exam to pursue engineering at Chiang Mai University, the top-ranked institution in the country, to live with Meen and assigns Meen to take care of Tul. Meen sees this as a good opportunity for him to move to a dorm near the university and have Tul take care of Nirand instead. But before moving out, Meen learns that behind Tul's excellence as a student lies a struggle with depression. Driven by his medical training and compassion, Meen makes the selfless choice to abandon the dormitory plan to support and care for Tul. As they live together for a while, their relationship develops beyond just "brothers." Both must choose between a romantic relationship or ending it as mere "brothers" to fulfill their life goals.
title: DogBro

overview: A full-fledged healing trip emotional drama about an idol-turned-travel reporter who has never been in the center in her life, realizing the true success and meaning of life by going on requested trips.
title: My Lovely Journey

overview: Brothers joint apartment will become too small for both of them and all their loves and whose experiences they drew material for the series.
title: Vse punce mojga brata

overview: What You Need to Know is the fast, fresh way to stay ahead of the conversation as viewers start their day. From breaking headlines and the day's biggest stories to entertainment buzz and viral videos, the show has everything you need to know.
title: What You Need To Know

overview: Peyton Place was America's first truly successful primetime serial. The series was the brainchild of veteran producer Paul Monash. Impressed with the success of Britain's monster hit Coronation Street, Monash wanted to import that UK series; however, ABC executives felt that US audiences would not cotton to the thick British accents and kitchen-sink drama. Monash countered with a slightly revamped version of Peyton Place, which had been a wildly popular novel by Grace Metalious and subsequent Hollywood film starring Lana Turner and Diane Varsi. While the book and series centered on the pious, hypocritical behavior of New England residents, the TV series eschewed most of that lasciviousness and told the story of life in a small New England village. In many ways, the TV program resembled a dramatic version of The Andy Griffith Show, featuring a recurring cast of warm, sympathetic characters.
title: Peyton Place

overview: Reactions is a show that uncovers the chemistry all around us. We answer the burning questions you've always wanted to ask, blending the worlds of science and every-day life.
title: Reactions

overview: Sacred Planet with Gulnaz Khan is a four-part, four-hour series presented by the environmental journalist, Gulnaz Khan. Cinematic in its approach and global in its ambitions, the series was filmed in Africa, Asia, and North & South America. It is a deeply personal and often uplifting examination of how climate change is impacting some of the most hallowed places on the planet, and how faith leaders worldwide are seeking to mitigate the worst consequences of the climate crisis by drawing on traditional knowledge, practices, and beliefs.
title: Sacred Planet with Gulnaz Khan

overview: A nomadic curator spends his days rummaging through lost footage that he randomly "finds" from strangers. He's so proud of his collection that he's decided to share it with everyone in this episodic found footage anthology dubbed his Midnight Feature.
title: Midnight Feature

overview: With nearly a billion views on YouTube alone, "IMPAULSIVE" has become one of the world's biggest digital series since launching in November 2018. The show has featured interviews with some of the biggest and most intriguing names in entertainment, sports and culture, including WWE Superstars such as Cody Rhodes, Roman Reigns and Rhea Ripley. Other notable guests have included Tom Brady, Kevin Hart, Machine Gun Kelly, MrBeast and more. "IMPAULSIVE" is co-hosted by Mike Majlak, a founder of the digital series alongside Logan Paul, and a USA Today best-selling author and multi-platform content creator with more than 4.4 million followers across YouTube, Instagram and other social platforms.
title: Impaulsive

overview: Jaime's Treetop Tales invites children into Jaime's cosy treehouse for imaginative story time adventures inspired by everyday objects. Led by Jaime Amor, a beloved storyteller with over 400 million views across all social platforms, the series encourages simulated play and creative thinking through original characters and playful narratives, while offering calm, connected moments for young viewers.
title: Jaime's Treetop Tales

overview: Death of a Showjumper details the shocking death of Katie Simpson, a promising young showjumper, which devastated the horse community in Northern Ireland, exposing hypocrisy, secrets and violence under the surface of a seemingly perfect and privileged world. When Katie Simpson, died unexpectedly in 2020, the majority of the horse community accepted that she had taken her own life but a local journalist questioned the official conclusion. Katie's death triggered a memory of an old case she covered, a case with too many similarities to Katie's. At the centre of her suspicions was Katie's sister's partner, an influential champion showjumper, jockey and horse trainer, Jonathan Creswell.
title: Death of a Showjumper

overview: Having explored the collections of the National Portrait Gallery and the National Gallery, Kate Bryan goes behind the scenes at Tate Britain. The collection includes works by some of the most celebrated artists in British culture, from William Blake to Chris Ofili, as well as an astonishing archive.
title: Stories from Tate Britain

overview: This two-episode prequel explores the events leading up to the airport occupation, revealing key backstories and the circumstances that set the stage for the looming crisis.
title: Shin Kuukou Senkyo Mae: Run, Mouse, Run!

overview: When a broadcasting station is overtaken by a radical group, a seasoned investigator faces a tense standoff that threatens to disrupt the nation's communication. As secrets unravel, he must outwit the occupiers to restore order.
title: Housoukyoku Senkyo

overview: Political intrigue surrounding a Paris Capuchin monastery describes only one aspect of "Ainsi soient-ils". It's not overly melodramatic, and, while respecting the core humanitarianism of Christianity, it pulls no punches lambasting church hierarchy. The series follows the lives of five seminarians and the power struggle between the seminary head and his superiors in Rome, as well as the dissonance of a medieval religious institution in a modern, secular society.
title: Ainsi soient-ils

overview: When a beautiful girl, Kurumi Hayaka, transfers into the class of Hideo Aiba, the head of the photography club at high school, Aiba falls in love with Kurumi. However, he soon finds himself at the mercy of her devilish attitude and behavior. What will happen to their twisted SM-like relationship?
title: Sundome

overview: Golf-based game show in which celebrities win money for charity and prizes for their contestant partners.
title: Full Swing

overview: Explores a group of interconnected individuals who are collectively haunted by a murder of one of their own, serving as the catalyst to unravel secrets, suspicions, and betrayals between friends.
title: A Killer Among Friends

overview: Sweet Revenge is a stylish romantic revenge drama about Mariko, a quiet and unassuming woman who secretly runs a company called Sweet Revenge Inc. Her mission: to help women who've been cruelly dumped by making the offending men fall for her — only to ruthlessly break their hearts in return. A master of disguise and seduction, Mariko transforms into the ideal woman for each target, tailoring her looks, personality, and behavior to their desires. But as she dishes out justice one case at a time, the line between revenge and emotion begins to blur. Sharp, clever, and unexpectedly heartfelt, Sweet Revenge delivers both satisfaction and insight into the games of love.
title: Sweet Revenge

overview: B:My Boyz aims to create a new global boy group. The show will feature 30 talents selected from Korea, Japan, China, Thailand, and beyond, with the goal to debut as the next generation idols. The participants will compete against each other in various fields including vocals, performance, and producing, with the current top idol seniors selecting the next idols.
title: B:My Boyz

overview: A TV show anchor vanishes in 1995 under mysterious circumstances, but the biggest leads in decades could mean finally solving the chilling cold case.
title: Her Last Broadcast: The Abduction of Jodi Huisentruit

overview: What happens when two lost souls—one a woman weary of adult life, the other a boy with nowhere to go—start living under the same roof? Ai, a 30-year-old office worker numbed by the monotony of daily life, finds herself making an impulsive decision one rainy night: taking in a stray high school boy with cat-like instincts and nowhere to belong. His name is Nagisa—mysterious, quiet, and untethered from the world. What begins as an unusual cohabitation gradually evolves into something deeper. As the days pass in their modest apartment, filled with shared meals, silences, and small moments of understanding, a delicate bond forms between them—one that challenges their assumptions about age, love, loneliness, and family. But how long can something so fragile last? And when the world inevitably intrudes, will the connection they've built survive? A gentle, bittersweet tale of connection, emotional healing, and the quiet stirrings of love—told through the rhythm of everyday life.
title: Neko Kare: Shounen wo Kau

overview: A salaryman who lives a happy life with his wife and daughter in Tokyo is suddenly transferred to Kagoshima, a place full of memories where he spent his junior high school years. However, soon after arriving at his new post, he reunites with his first love, and along with bittersweet memories, a hidden Pandora's box opens...
title: Tanshin Hanabi

overview: Honoka Asami, a pure but plain and introverted temporary office worker, is forced to work in a company where harassment is rampant and has nothing to do but endure. Fukase Nozomi, a new beautiful employee, stands out at work, catching the eyes of senior employees, and then she becomes close to Asami also deeply resonates with each other. After meeting and becoming close to Nozomi, Honoka gradually begins to feel that every day is fun. Meanwhile, a senior employee who had been harassing Honoka was forced to resign due to an incident that occurred in the company, causing a commotion. But that was just the beginning!
title: Shanai Shokeinin: Kanojo wa Teki wo Keshiteiku

overview: Chloe Ayling: My Unbelievable Kidnapping is a documentary series featuring Chloe Ayling as she recounts, in her own words, the ordeal of her 2017 kidnapping and explores how it continues to shape her life. Giving her first documentary interview since her abductors' conviction, Chloe Ayling revisits the story of her time in captivity and tries to come to terms with what took place, the media reaction and why many people refused to believe her.
title: Chloe Ayling: My Unbelievable Kidnapping

overview: Iron Chef America is an American cooking show based on Fuji Television's Iron Chef, and is the second American adaptation of the series, following the failed Iron Chef USA. The show is produced by Food Network, which also carried a dubbed version of the original Iron Chef. Like the original Japanese program, the program is a culinary game show. In each episode, a new challenger chef competes against one of the resident "Iron Chefs" in a one-hour cooking competition based on a secret ingredient or ingredients, and sometimes theme.
title: Iron Chef America

overview: Oleg and his father move to a quiet science city near Moscow, but he is quiet only at first glance. Arriving at a new school in the middle of the school year, the guy finds out that two girls from his class went missing the day before, and soon another victim appears.… However, against the background of these disturbing events, Oleg unexpectedly finds new friends. This is a group of once dysfunctional guys who have become leaders in just a couple of months thanks to the efforts of their homeroom teacher Baev. Oleg immediately attracts his attention, and soon the guy discovers the secret of a secret society, whose members can activate their physical and mental abilities. But what will be the price of these changes?
title: Тайный знак

overview: A simple rural girl, Jian Dan, meets the mathematics prodigy Han Yansheng at university. Due to an accident, Han Yansheng develops a swimming-related stress disorder. With kindness and perseverance, Jian Dan stands by his side and helps him overcome his inner fears. With support from their friends, the two grow together, finding both love and courage along the way.
title: Love Formula

overview: Thup, an orphan cursed with extraordinary senses, is drawn into investigating a mysterious murder case stretching across decades alongside the more rational police captain Singha, who dismisses all things occult. But what they face defies logic; this case is stitched together by ancient beliefs, supernatural forces, and the darkest corners of human desire. Every five years, new victims are lured by faith—victims drawn into temples by spiritual devotion, only to be sacrificed in a sinister ritual meant to prolong the killer's life. Thup and Singha must blend forensic science and ancient sorcery, navigating threats both visible and invisible. As the truth unravels, so too do the walls between them, until reluctant allies grow closer than either ever expected.
title: Goddess Bless You from Death

overview: A disgraced journalist returns to Dirty Neck, his Florida hometown, to become a local hero with the knack of reporting lurid stories of "stupid people doing stupid things", much to the chagrin of the town's controlling and shifty mayor.
title: Dirty Neck
